summary:
Main
Last week, constrained passage through Hormuz was the story. This week, the cost of moving through it has becomethe louder one. Tanker availability has tightened dramatically as Gulf flows, security concerns and disrupted alternatives compete for the same ships, with some VLCC employment reportedly exceeding USD 1 million per day.
